message.reasoning_content:
The kernel sums row-wise in float32 sequentially. Input has huge values (~1048576*integers up to 32) with +w and -w pairs plus small values. Reference sums in real arithmetic: exact sum is sum of small values (0.25..0.75)*64 ≈ small, since w and -w cancel exactly. Naive float32 sequential summation may accumulate catastrophic error: partial sums can be huge (up to ~32*1048576*32 ≈ 1e9), and adding 0.25 to 1e9 loses precision. Final result reference ~ up to 48. Error could be several ULP of 1e9 ≈ 128, so E could be large. Need to run probe.

Record claim and run probe.
